gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1414 opened 2020 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 735.556m. During 2020 the syndicate recorded a prior-accident-years run-off deficit (adverse development) of GBP 33.5m (4.56% of opening gross reserves), split into a GBP 20.3m deficit on reinsurance acceptances and a GBP 13.2m deficit on direct business. Key drivers cited included adverse prior-year development arising from wildfire subrogation (notably Camp Wildfire) and an increased estimate on the prior marine Golden Ray loss, together with reinsurance/subrogation effects. Current year catastrophe events (Hurricane Laura) and the COVID-19 pandemic contributed material current-year losses but the quantified prior-year deterioration is primarily linked to wildfire subrogation and specific marine large-loss movement.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and the prior-year run-off deficit are explicitly stated and highly reliable. Allocation of prior year deterioration to individual direct lines (Property, Marine) is based on narrative references (Camp Wildfire, Golden Ray) and net amounts reported for those events; some LOB-level amounts are not fully quantified in the report and have been left null where not explicitly stated. 'Other' direct LOB figures in the segmental table had very small values; percentages rounded to two decimal places. The report mixes direct and accepted reinsurance; 'Reinsurance Acceptances' has been reported as a single consolidated line per instructions.
